claim: Bartholomeus carries 2 Michelin stars in the 2026 guide and is located at Zeedijk 267, Heist.
quote: Bartholomeus – Heist. Two Stars: Excellent cooking. Zeedijk 267, 8301 Heist.

claim: Bartholomeus street address is Zeedijk-Heist 267, 8301 Heist with phone 050 51 75 76.
Brasserie Bristol sits at Zeedijk-Heist 291, roughly 24 metres east of Bartholomeus along the same seafront promenade.
quote: Brasserie Bristol: Zeedijk-Heist 291 – approximately 24 meters away

claim: Brasserie Bristol at Zeedijk 291 partners with three on-promenade residences — Residentie Morrisson (2-3 bedroom apartments and double rooms), Residentie Renée (studios for two), and Residentie Bristol (sea-view apartments) — sold as 'apartment comfort with hotel service'.
quote: Residentie Morrisson – 2-3 bedroom apartments plus double rooms. Residentie Renée – studios designed for two guests. Residentie Bristol – apartments with sea views, the best location on the seafront.

claim: Residentie Bristol studios on Zeedijk 290 cost €310 for a winter weekend (2 nights) and €545 for a summer weekend; 2-room apartments run €1,120-€2,380 per week depending on season; final cleaning and linens included, parking €20/day.
quote: Winter: €310 (2 nights). Summer: €545 (2 nights). 2-Room Apartments range from €1,120/week in winter to €2,380/week in July-August.

claim: Residentie Renée at Zeedijk 290 offers sea-view studios for two persons, run by the same Residenties Delacourt operator as Bristol.
quote: studio's met zicht op zee designed for two persons. Address: Zeedijk 290, 8301 Knokke-Heist.

claim: Residentie Mariposa apartment at Zeedijk 72 in Heist has 2 bedrooms, sea views over the Baai van Heist nature reserve, 9.3/10 guest rating, and rents from roughly $126/night.
quote: 72 Zeedijk, Knokke-Heist. Beautiful apartment with wonderful views on the sea, the Baai van Heist nature reserve, the beach and the Zeebrugge harbor. 94% rating based on 90 ratings.

claim: Studio Heist apartment at Zeedijk 101, Heist scores 8.2/10 across 26 Booking.com reviews and is a 3-minute walk from Heist-Aan-Zee beach.
quote: Studio Heist offers accommodations in Knokke-Heist, a 3-minute walk from Heist-Aan-Zee. Rated 8.2 by recent guests with 26 reviews.

claim: Archipel beachfront apartment at Zeedijk-Heist 145 is rated 9.2/10 across 17 verified reviews and is 100 metres from Heist-Aan-Zee beach.
quote: Archipel - Located at Zeedijk-Heist 145 1, Knokke-Heist, 8301, rated 9.2 with 17 verified reviews. Just 100 metres from Heist-Aan-Zee.

claim: Heist sub-municipality of Knokke-Heist has 188 bookable accommodation options; top-rated picks include Loft Exclusif (9.7/10, 8-min walk to Heist beach, from $328) and Residentie Mariposa (9.6/10, 5-min walk, from $307).
quote: Total accommodation options: 188 hotels and places to stay available in Heist. Loft Exclusif - 9.7/10 (49 reviews), 8-minute walk from Heist-Aan-Zee, $328.20/night. Residentie Mariposa - 9.6/10 (41 reviews), 5-minute walk, $307.57/night.

claim: B&B Aquavit at Sint-Jorisstraat 7 in Heist is a 2-room design boutique B&B (24 m² Deluxe Double/Twin), adults-only, rated 9.6/10 across 22 reviews.
quote: Address: Sint-Jorisstraat 7, 8300 Knokke-Heist. 2 rooms total. Deluxe Double or Twin Room 24m². Rating: Exceptional — 9.6/10 based on 22 reviews.

claim: Studio Heyst on Kardinaal Mercierstraat sits about 100 metres from the beach, perfect 5.0/5 on TripAdvisor (1 review), and rents from roughly $157/night.
quote: Address: Kardinaal Mercierstraat, Knokke-Heist 8301. Approximately 100 meters from the beach. Guest Rating: 5.0 out of 5. Starting Price: $157 per night.

claim: B&B Morpheus at Zeetrapper 16 has 2 rooms at €120/night and is a ~10-minute walk to the Heist seafront, set in a quiet residential street.
quote: Zeetrapper 16, 8301 Knokke-Heist. Approximately 10 minutes on foot to beach. 2 rooms (Brise-Lames and De Kelle). €120 per night.

claim: B&B B-eaufort at Kardinaal Mercierstraat 20 in central Heist is about 40 metres from the seafront but offers no on-site parking, WiFi or TV.
quote: Kardinaal Mercierstraat 20, 8301 Knokke-Heist. Located 'on slechts 40m van de zee' (approximately 40 meters from the sea). The B&B does not offer parking, internet, TV, or other standard hotel services.

claim: Hotel Du Soleil at Patriottenstraat 15 is a 3-star family-run hotel in Duinbergen, 50 metres from the sea, with restaurant and breakfast buffet — but it is in Duinbergen, ~2 km east of Bartholomeus.
quote: Hotel du Soleil. Patriottenstraat 15, 8301 Duinbergen. Quiet 3-star hotel located in Duinbergen, 50 meters from the sea, beach, and promenade.

claim: Hotel Britannia, the most prominent traditional hotel in greater Knokke-Heist, sits in Het Zoute (Elizabetlaan 85) — roughly 1 hour 4 minutes walking from Heist, so not a walking-distance option for Bartholomeus.
quote: Hotel Britannia | Elizabetlaan 85, Knokke-Heist, 8300. From Hotel Britannia, Heist is accessible by taxi in 12 minutes or by walking in 1 hour 4 minutes.

claim: Hotel St. Yves at Zeedijk-Heist 204 is a 3-star year-round seafront hotel with 8 rooms (TV, mini-bar, safe, luxury bath), specializing in gastronomic packages and lobster.
quote: St. Yves Hotel. Zeedijk-Heist 204, 8301 Knokke-Heist. Three-star establishment. 8 rooms total. TV, min-bar, telephone, radio, safe, luxury bathroom with bath. Known for lobster dishes and weekend/week stays.

claim: Hotel St. Yves scores 3.8/5 on TripAdvisor across only 6 reviews; cleanliness (3.6) and service (3.0) lag while sleep quality and value rate 4.0, with rooms 'modern and recently refurbished' but a thin review pool.
quote: Overall Rating: 3.8 out of 5 bubbles (6 reviews). Cleanliness: 3.6, Service: 3.0, Sleep Quality: 4.0, Value: 4.0. Rooms are 'modern and recently refurbished,' with some offering sea views.

claim: Hotel St. Yves rooms start at roughly €100/night.
quote: Hotel St.Yves (3 sterren) in Knokke-Heist, België boeken • Kamers vanaf 100.00 EUR per nacht
